summary: Public projects created on 8 August 2026: 4 repos.
intro: Claude Code plugin architecture and repository cleanup tooling appeared alongside certification planning work. The plugin projects cover a workspace vault for sustained agent work and a specification-first certification workflow, while the other tools prune git working copies and GitHub repositories and survey certifications against written requirements.

projects.name: Claude Plugin Workspace Vault
projects.description: An architecture for Claude Code plugins that do sustained work: a public plugin, a private workspace instantiated from a template repo, and a vault at ~/.claude-plugins/<name>/ for user data.

projects.name: Repo Purge
projects.description: Prune git working copies and their GitHub repositories: one alphabetical list of every repo under a directory, a window and a keystroke-driven review CLI, and deletion locally, on GitHub, or both

projects.name: Spec Led Certification
projects.description: Choose a professional certification spec-first: write the requirements, then survey and score the market against them. An agent workflow, as a template repo.

projects.name: Spec Led Certification Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: choose a certification specification-first — interview, freeze a weighted scorecard, then survey and score the market against it.
